title: Validate Evidence Records
description: Draft command semantic instance for the repeatable USF evidence validator gate.
purpose: Validate committed proof-evidence and evidence-envelope records for schema shape, source/reference resolution, provider/environment safety, proof overclaim, freshness shape, and report/evidence authority boundaries.
outputs: JSON validator result on standard output
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates invalid evidence shape, unresolved evidence/source references, proof overclaim, provider or environment claim violation, stale pass report, or unreadable input. Generated validator output is a report and must not replace evidence records.
aiGuidance: Use this command as a validation gate for evidence records only. Do not treat a clean generated result as proof execution or as authority above the validated records.
